title: Slow English Listening Intermediate Practice -- Talking about 👉My Hobbies

header.titleZh: 慢速英語聽力中級練習--談👉我的嗜好
header.titleEn: Slow English Listening Intermediate Practice -- Talking about 👉My Hobbies

sentences.en: Welcome to my slow English podcast for levels B1 or A2.
sentences.tc: 歡迎來到我的 B1 或 A2 級慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: Today I will repeat the conversation twice once clearly.
sentences.tc: 今天我把談話內容重複兩遍，一次清楚。

sentences.en: The second a bit faster.
sentences.tc: 第二個有點快。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about sports and hobbies.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談運動和嗜好。

tags.note: 看到 hobbies 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 sports 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I have always enjoyed playing sports anything from soccer to ballet.
sentences.tc: 我一直喜歡參加從足球到芭蕾舞等各種運動。

sentences.en: I have always loved participating in different social activities throughout my whole life.
sentences.tc: 我一生都非常喜歡參與不同的社會活動。

sentences.en: I have gone to soccer cheerleading basketball gymnastics dance and baseball.
sentences.tc: 我去了足球、啦啦隊、籃球、體操、舞蹈和棒球。

sentences.en: Do you play any sports?
sentences.tc: 你參加什麼運動嗎？

tags.note: 看到 sports 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 enjoy 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: Do you prefer team sports or individual sports?
sentences.tc: 你喜歡團隊運動還是個人運動？

sentences.en: I don't enjoy watching sports as much as I enjoy playing them.
sentences.tc: 我不像喜歡參加體育比賽那樣喜歡觀看體育比賽。

sentences.en: I do love watching gymnastics competitions and dance shows like Dance Moms or Dancing with the Stars.
sentences.tc: 我確實喜歡看體操比賽和舞蹈節目，例如《舞蹈媽媽》或《與星共舞》。

sentences.en: Do you think watching sports is as enjoyable as playing them I also enjoy going to the gym but if?
sentences.tc: 你認為觀看體育比賽和參加比賽一樣有趣嗎？我也喜歡去健身房，但如果呢？

tags.note: 看到 sports 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 enjoy 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I don't have time to go to the gym I always make sure to go for a jog jogging for me is very therapeutic it helps me clear my mind and stops.
sentences.tc: 我沒有時間去健身房，我總是確保去慢跑，慢跑對我來說非常有治療作用，它可以幫助我理清思緒並停下來。

sentences.en: The overthinking physical activity not only helps my body but also helps my mind.
sentences.tc: 過度思考的身體活動不僅對我的身體有幫助，對我的思想也有幫助。

sentences.en: Is there any type of exercise you do to help you clear your head having a clear mind how can exercise help us to stop worrying about things?
sentences.tc: 有沒有什麼類型的運動可以幫助你理清思緒，頭腦清醒，運動如何幫助我們停止擔心事情？

sentences.en: Sometimes hobbies aren't physical Hobbies like drawing writing knitting gardening or cooking can be a big help to mental health as well.
sentences.tc: 有時嗜好不是身體上的嗜好，例如繪畫、寫作、編織、園藝或烹飪等嗜好也對心理健康有很大幫助。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy non-physical Hobbies if so which ones?
sentences.tc: 你是否喜歡非物質嗜好（如果有）是哪些？

sentences.en: Do you enjoy?
sentences.tc: 你喜歡嗎？

sentences.en: I have gone to soccer cheerleading basketball gymnastics and baseball.
sentences.tc: 我參加過足球、啦啦隊、籃球、體操和棒球。

sentences.tc: 我沒有時間去健身房，我總是確保去慢跑，慢跑對我來說非常有治療作用，它可以幫助我理清思緒。

sentences.en: Stops me from overthinking you know physical activity is good for the body.
sentences.tc: 讓我不再想太多，你知道體力活動對身體有好處。

sentences.en: It is good for the mind.
sentences.tc: 這對頭腦有好處。

sentences.tc: 有什麼類型的運動可以幫助你理清思緒，運動如何幫助我們停止擔心事情？

sentences.tc: 有時嗜好不是身體上的嗜好，例如繪畫、寫作、編織、園藝或烹飪。

sentences.tc: 謝謝你，我將把本課的一些詞彙留在這裡。
